svg.title: KurtShape concept mockup: Feature editor states · ambitious
svg.desc: Concept mockup, not a screenshot. Adds in-viewport handles, expected wait, one-click repairs and history position.

g.text: Ambitious feature editor: pending → valid → error
Same FeaturePanel skeleton (header · scrolling form · verdict strip); states driven by the existing preview sequence/generation keys.
Provisional preview shown · Confirm waits for the exact
Merges with Plate · Confirm (Enter) commits one Undo step
6 mm exceeds the 4.5 mm wall beside Edge7
Fillet failed: radius too large for Edge7
Reduce the radius below 4.5 mm or remove Edge7 · values
Plate · Edge2 no longer exists after the last edit
CONCEPT MOCKUP · not a screenshot of implemented behavior
Adds in-viewport handles, expected wait, one-click repairs and history position.
Text Confirm/Cancel buttons (primary blue when valid) and a 'Feature 4 of 7' position so the editor says where in history the feature lands.
In-viewport affordances: a flip-direction handle at the preview tip and a volume delta chip beside the preview, both Coin SoAnnotation overlays bound
Pending shows the expected wait ('~0.4 s · exact worker') from the responsiveness timing samples, so a slow model explains itself.
Error offers a one-click repair ('Use 4.5 mm') when the kernel diagnostic can propose one (fillet max radius probe), otherwise the same text guidance
Missing references are shown in red with a 'missing' tag and the reference picker outline turns red; the healthy edge stays listed so the user removes
Cost: needs a kernel-side probe for the suggested value and an overlay layer; the restrained option needs neither.
